title: Effect of temperature on the carbonization process of cationic carbon dots: a physicochemical and in vitro study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12814-12824
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00062A, Paper
Open Access

Nicolás Santos, Paula A. Santana, Igor Osorio-Roman, Carlos Jara-Gutiérrez, Joan Villena, Manuel Ahumada
Carbon dots prepared at different carbonization temperatures showed an increase in their optical properties, along with a decrease in cytotoxicity towards bacterial strains and both tumor and non-tumor cell lines as the temperature increased.
